bead.title: claude-tui: implement PTY session pool with /clear-between-turns and orphan reaper
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013 §3 requires a session pool keyed by working directory so consecutive turns reuse the same PTY session with /clear issued between them, and any orphaned PTY child processes must be reaped on shutdown.

ROOT CAUSE:
- internal/harnesses/claudetui/harness.go: no session-pool data structure; each turn would spawn a fresh PTY, defeating reuse.
- internal/pty/: no shutdown reaper that enumerates and terminates leftover child processes when the harness exits.

PROPOSED FIX:
1. Add a session pool in claudetui.Harness keyed by working directory; on RunTurn, look up an existing session or open a new one via internal/pty/.
2. Between turns on the same key, write /clear to the session before injecting the new prompt; verify the CLI acknowledged the clear before proceeding.
3. On harness Shutdown, enumerate live PTY children and reap them within a bounded timeout (SIGTERM then SIGKILL).

NON-SCOPE:
- The PTY turn driver and intermediate ProgressEvent emission (sibling child A).
- AccountHarness and QuotaHarness implementations (sibling child C).
- Performance benchmarking and 2x/10ms ratchets (sibling child D).
- ModelDiscoveryHarness and no-static-fallback enforcement.
- Capability baseline rows, evidence IDs, ADR-013 status promotion.
- Cassette-driven static fallback for production code (forbidden by fizeau-89eca738).
- Service-side changes beyond what child #1 already wired.
- Redesigning the hook-conflict arbitration layer.

Depends on child #1 and sibling child A. Governing artifacts: ADR-013 §3, CONTRACT-004, internal/pty/ library.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestClaudeTuiSessionPoolReusesAndClears asserts /clear is issued between consecutive turns sharing a working directory and that the underlying PTY session is reused (same pid).
2) TestClaudeTuiOrphanReaper asserts that on harness shutdown any leftover PTY child processes are reaped within a bounded timeout.
3) go test ./... -count=1 is green.
4) lefthook run pre-commit is green.
